method: Forward-drawdown labels: dd5 = SPX -5% within 20 sessions; dd10 = SPX -10% within 60 sessions. AUC computed via Mann-Whitney rank-sum (no sklearn dep) on the full backtest. v1 baselines are the published Section 9 numbers; v3 is freshly recomputed on the same label definitions.

versions.label: CRI v3
versions.notes: v3: VIX floor 13, RoC denom 40, VVIX floor 80, tactical pullback sub-score (saturates at -4% from 20d high).

interpretation: v3 must score >= v1 on both auc_dd5 and auc_dd10 for the OOS gate to pass. The gate is enforced by tests/integration/regime/test_cri_oos_gate.py — CI will block merge on regression.
